mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 AM, here is today's balanced dish. It is 75 degrees and clear near the Verona Public Library, but please be aware of an air quality alert as the index has reached 51.

The city has two major updates: residents should inspect their mailboxes to ensure they can withstand winter plow operations, and students in grades K through 12 are invited to design a new I Voted sticker for the November election by submitting entries to City Hall by July 22.

There is a lot going on in town today, including yoga at Insight Wellness, Concerts in the Park, and trivia at Hop Haus Brewing Company, plus live music continues tomorrow at Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company.
In a report from the police department, on July 13, a 36-year-old man was arrested for his first O-W-I offense after officers found his vehicle stuck on a large rock.
Today is the perfect day to head over to Culver's for the Really Reese's flavor of the day. They are open until 10 PM, so you have plenty of time to make a trip before they lock the doors tonight.
